Market-summary fixtures: trimmed official OpenAPI responses recorded on 2026-11-04 in `p40-probe`. Index feeds keep both dated rows. MI_MARGN keeps the first 100 stock rows; TPEx margin keeps the first 50 rows. Unused columns are removed; blank values and dates are preserved. These sample sums are not whole-market totals. `market_headers.json` retains only Date, Content-Type and Last-Modified from the recorded response headers.
